description:
This process begins when a potential customer inquires about a product or service.
Sales staff or customer support collects relevant information and addresses any concerns or questions.
If the customer is interested, they are guided through selecting the appropriate product or service.
Next, the sales representative provides a quote, and after approval from the customer, the process moves to order placement.
The order is then recorded in the system, and the customer receives confirmation of their order.
The process ends when the order is successfully placed and confirmed.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomerOrder"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/customer-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Customer approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CustomerOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Potential customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderProcess"
                      name="Customer inquiry and order process"
                      processRef="Process_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry"
                      name="Product or service inquiry"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry"
                      messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Information"
                      name="Relevant information"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer"
                      targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Guidance"
                      name="Product or service selection guidance"
                      sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote"
                      name="Quote"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval"
                      name="Customer approval"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval"
                      messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation"
                      name="Order confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Order"
                name="Process customer inquiry and order"
                isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Customer inquires">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InquiryToCollect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Inquiry"
                                  messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation"
               name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InquiryToCollect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectToAddress</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns"
               name="Address customer concerns and questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectToAddress</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AddressToInterestDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerInterest"
                           name="Is the customer interested?"
                           default="Flow_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AddressToInterestDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection"
               name="Guide customer through product or service selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GuideToQuote</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote"
                   name="Sales representative provides quote"
                   messageRef="Message_Quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GuideToQuote</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_QuoteToApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApproval"
                      name="Receive customer approval"
                      messageRef="Message_Approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_QuoteToApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovalToPlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovalToPlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceToRecord</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in the system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceToRecord</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecordToConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation"
                   name="Send order confirmation"
                   messageRef="Message_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecordToConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConfirmationToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"
                   name="Order successfully placed and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConfirmationToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested"
                   name="Customer is not interested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InquiryToCollect"
                       sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry"
                       targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToAddress"
                       sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation"
                       targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressToInterestDecision"
                       sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CustomerInterest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested"
                       name="Customer is interested"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterest"
                       targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerIsInterested = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested"
                       name="Customer is not interested"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterest"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GuideToQuote"
                       sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection"
                       targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuoteToApproval"
                       sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote"
                       targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovalToPlaceOrder"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApproval"
                       targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceToRecord"
                       sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder"
                       targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToConfirmation"
                       sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder"
                       targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToEnd"
                       sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
